info.name: Inventory Backend
info.description:
REST API for **inventory-backend** (Node.js + MongoDB).

**Base URL:** `http://localhost:8000` (variable `baseUrl`)

**Auth:** Run **Auth → Login** first; the test script saves `token` for protected routes. Use **Auth → Logout** to invalidate the token server-side (also clear `token` on the client).

**Login:** Any active user can sign in with the **email and password** set when their account was created (`POST /api/users`).

**Seed users** (other demo users use `ChangeMe123!` unless `SEED_DEFAULT_PASSWORD` is set):
- `bandohkwaku@gmail.com` — Administrator (password: `123456`)
- `gra@ladepuls.com` — GRA Reporter
- `light@ladepuls.com` — Cashier (Lighting)
- `multi@ladepuls.com` — Cashier (Lighting + Sanitary Ware)

**Roles:** Admins with `manage_roles` entitlement can create custom roles and assign entitlements. Run **Roles → List roles** to get `roleId` for user creation.

**Staff & Users:**
- Create staff first (**Staff → Create staff**); `employeeId` is auto-generated (`EMP-001`, …).
- Create users with `staffId` — display **name** is taken from `staff.fullName` (do not send `name`). Use **Staff → List staff** for the name dropdown.

**Notes:**
- All records use MongoDB `_id`.
- Product create uses **multipart/form-data** (`image` optional).
- Settings logo upload uses **multipart/form-data** (`logo` optional); path stored as `business.logoUrl`.
- Sales use `items[]`, server pricing, atomic stock, receipt id `R-{BASE36}`, GRA tax breakdown (multiplier 1.219).
- Proformas use `PI-{BASE36}`; no stock impact.
- Expenses: `E-####` ids; summary + list filters; mark paid via `PATCH .../mark-paid`.
- Errors: `{ "message": "..." }` or `{ "error": "..." }`.

item.name: API index
item.description: Lists main paths. Use this first if routes return 404 (wrong server or port).

item.name: Users
item.description:
Requires `users` entitlement. Bearer token from Login.

**Flow:**
1. **Staff → Create staff** / **List staff** for the name dropdown (`staffId`)
2. **Roles → List roles** — saves `roleId`
3. **Create user** with `staffId` (name is copied from staff; do not send `name`)

Optional PATCH fields: `staffId`, `email`, `password`, `roleId`, `categoryIds`, `active`. Sending `name` returns 400.

item.name: Create user
item.description: Requires `staffId`. Response `name` is the linked staff member's `fullName`.

item.name: Update user
item.description: Cannot set `name` directly. To change display name, update the staff member or send a new `staffId`.

item.name: Roles
item.description: Requires `manage_roles` entitlement for CRUD. List entitlements is available to any authenticated user.

item.name: Settings
Get settings
item.description: Public. Returns business (including `logoUrl`) and receipt preferences.

item.name: Update settings (admin)
item.description: Requires `settings` entitlement and Bearer token. JSON body for business/receipt fields only. Does not upload a logo file — use **Upload logo**.

item.name: Upload logo (admin)
item.description: Requires `settings` entitlement and Bearer token. Multipart form with file field `logo` (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP; max 2 MB). Replaces any existing logo and sets `business.logoUrl`. Saves `logoUrl` collection variable on success.

formdata.description: Required for this request; JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP; max 2 MB

item.name: Clear logo (admin)
item.description: Requires `settings` entitlement and Bearer token. Removes the current logo file and sets `business.logoUrl` to null.

Business and receipt settings (singleton `_id: app`). GET is public. PATCH requires `settings` entitlement and Bearer token.

**Logo:** Upload via multipart field `logo` (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP; max 2 MB). Stored as `business.logoUrl` (e.g. `/uploads/logos/<file>`), served under `{{baseUrl}}/uploads/...`. Use **Clear logo** or `clearLogo=true` to remove.

item.name: Delete category
item.description: 409 if products are assigned to this category.

item.name: List products
item.description: Optional query: `categoryId`

item.name: Create product
item.description: Multipart form. `sku` is optional. `categoryId`, `name`, `sellingPrice`, `unit`, `stockQuantity`, `reorderAt` required.

formdata.description: Optional; letters, digits, hyphens, underscores; unique when set.
Optional; JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP; max 2 MB

item.name: Update product (JSON)
item.description: Send only fields to change. Set `"sku": null` to clear SKU.

item.name: Delete product
item.description: 409 if product appears on saved purchases.

item.name: Suppliers summary
item.description: totalSuppliers, active/inactive counts, categoriesCount, outstandingGhs.

item.name: List suppliers
item.description: Optional query: `status=active`, `category=groceries`

  "name": "Wholesale Grocers",

item.name: Delete supplier
item.description: 409 if linked to purchases.

item.name: Purchases summary
item.description: purchaseCount, unpaidInvoicesCount, totalSpend, outstanding, currency.

item.name: List purchases
item.description: Query: `page`, `limit`, `q`, `supplierId`, `paymentStatus` (unpaid|partial|paid). Response: `items`, pagination. Each item includes `purchaseTotal`, `balance`, `paymentStatus`.

item.name: Create purchase
item.description: Increases stock on each line item.

item.name: Record payment
item.description: Adds to amountPaid and payments[]; recalculates balance and paymentStatus.

item.name: Delete purchase
item.description: Reverses stock; fails if stock would go negative.

item.name: Expenses
item.description:
Requires `expenses` entitlement and Bearer token from **Auth → Login**.

**Fields:** `expenseId` (`E-0001`), `date`, `category`, `description`, `reference` (optional), `chartAccount` (derived from category), `amount` (GHS), `status` (`Pending`|`Paid`). No paid-from / payment source field.

**Create:** set `status` to `Paid` or `markPaid: true` to mark paid on create.
**Mark paid:** `PATCH /api/expenses/:id/mark-paid`.

item.name: Expenses meta
item.description: categories, statuses, chartAccountByCategory.

item.name: Expenses summary
item.description: totalAmount, paidAmount, pendingAmount, pendingCount, expenseCount, currency.

item.name: List expenses
item.description: Query: `page`, `limit`, `q`, `status` (Pending|Paid), `category`. Response: `items`, pagination.

item.name: Create expense
item.description: Required: `date`, `category`, `description`, `amount`. Optional: `reference`, `status` / `markPaid`.

item.name: Create expense (pending)
item.description: Creates with status Pending (default).

item.name: Update expense
item.description: Partial update. Changing `category` also updates `chartAccount` unless you send `chartAccount`.

item.name: Mark expense paid
item.description: Sets status to Paid. 409 if already paid.

item.name: POS / Sales
item.description: Create sale requires Bearer token from **Auth → Login** and `sales_pos` entitlement. Response includes `servedByName` (logged-in attendant).

item.name: Complete sale
item.description: Server prices from catalog; atomic stock decrement. Receipt id `R-{BASE36}`. Optional `Idempotency-Key` header. `paymentMethod`: `Cash` or `Mobile Money`. Requires login.

item.name: List sales
item.description: Query: `page`, `limit`, `from`, `to`, `date`, `paymentMethod`, `receiptId`. Use `wrap=false` for plain array.

item.name: List proformas
item.description: Optional query: `status` (draft|sent|approved|expired).

item.name: Create proforma
item.description: Default status `sent`, validUntil +14 days. Does not affect stock.

item.name: Dashboard
item.description: Dashboard metrics, charts, and recent activity for the home screen.

item.name: Full dashboard
item.description: All dashboard data in one response: metrics, sales performance, top products, recent sales/restocks, and income/expense charts. Query: `days` (default 7), `topLimit` (default 5), `recentLimit` (default 10).

item.name: Dashboard summary
item.description: Legacy summary plus metric cards and recent sales. Backward-compatible with the original `/api/dashboard/summary` endpoint.

item.name: Metric cards
item.description: Today's sales, 7-day revenue, inventory units, and active customers with change percentages.

item.name: Sales performance chart
item.description: Daily sales revenue for the past N days. Query: `days` (default 7, max 90).

item.name: Top products chart
item.description: Best sellers by quantity. Query: `days` (default 7), `limit` (default 5).

item.name: Recent sales
item.description: Latest transactions for the dashboard table. Query: `limit` (default 10).

item.name: Recent restocks
item.description: Latest purchase line items (inventory updates). Query: `limit` (default 10).

item.name: Income & expense charts
item.description: Daily income (sales) and expenses (purchase spend) series. Query: `days` (default 7).

item.name: Staff
item.description:
Staff management. Requires `staff` or `payroll` entitlement. Bearer token from Login.

**employeeId** is auto-generated as `EMP-001`, `EMP-002`, … (do not send it on create).
**Users:** create a user account from a staff member via **Users → Create user** (`staffId`). Deleting staff fails if a user is linked.
**Attendance statuses:** present, absent, late, on_leave.
**Dates:** YYYY-MM-DD (UTC).
**History weeks:** week 1 = days 1–7 of the month, week 2 = 8–14, etc.

item.name: Staff summary
item.description: activeStaff, presentToday, absentToday, lateToday, unmarked. Optional `date` query.

item.name: Daily attendance
item.description: Active staff with status for a date (default today).

item.name: Attendance history
item.description: Weekly grid. Use `year`+`month`+`week` or `from`+`to`.

item.name: GRA tax report
item.description: Aggregated GRA breakdown from sales. Query: `from`, `to` (ISO dates).
